B01.name: 鲢鱼
B01.form: a laterally compressed body, small eyes set low on the head, a wide terminal mouth, the lower jaw slightly upturned, no barbels, a keeled belly from between the pectoral fin bases to the anus
B01.fins: the pectoral fins reaching only to the origin of the pelvic fins
B01.colour: 体呈银白色，各鳍灰白色

B02.name: 鳙鱼
B02.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a large head, a large terminal mouth, small eyes set low on the head, no barbels, a keeled belly
B02.fins: a long dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin
B02.markings: irregular blotches scattered along the flanks
B02.colour: 背部暗黑色，体侧散布不规则斑块，腹部银白色

B03.name: 草鱼
B03.form: an elongated cylindrical body, no ventral keel, a terminal arcuate mouth, no barbels, a blunt head, a short blunt snout, widely spaced eyes, medium-sized round scales
B03.fins: short pectoral fins, a dorsal fin without a spine, a slightly forked tail fin
B03.colour: 体茶黄色，背部青灰，腹部灰白，胸鳍、腹鳍灰黄色，其他各鳍淡灰色

B04.name: 鲮鱼
B04.form: a spindle-shaped laterally compressed body, a rounded belly, the back slightly elevated in front of the dorsal fin, a short head, eyes set on the sides and widely spaced, a small inferior mouth shaped as a horizontal slit, two pairs of barbels with the rostral pair stouter, medium-sized scales, a long caudal peduncle
B04.markings: a diamond-shaped blotch above and behind the pectoral fin base, a spot at the base of the tail fin in juveniles
B04.colour: 体上部青灰色，腹部银白色

B05.name: 罗非鱼
B05.form: an oval body, a rather large head, a short caudal peduncle, large cycloid scales
B05.colour: 雄鱼繁殖期体色蓝黑色，仅头下侧和鳃盖后缘白色，背鳍和尾鳍边缘红色明显，胸鳍淡红色；雌鱼体色灰黄色，背鳍和尾鳍略呈红色

B06.name: 鳊鱼
B06.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a small laterally compressed head, a terminal mouth, the upper jaw slightly longer than the lower, no barbels
B06.fins: a dorsal fin with a stout spine, a long anal fin with 29 to 33 branched rays, a deeply forked tail fin
B06.colour: 体背及头部背面青灰色，体侧银灰色，腹部银白色，各鳍边缘灰色

B07.name: 鲂鱼
B07.form: a flattened oval laterally compressed body, a high back, a large upward-slanting mouth, the lower jaw protruding, a caudal peduncle longer than or equal to its height
B07.fins: a dorsal fin with a smooth stout spine longer than the head, a row of spiny bony plates along the base of the dorsal and anal fins
B07.markings: a blotch on the upper middle of the flank, rows of stripes running along the flanks
B07.colour: 体背及两侧青灰色、银灰色，腹部银白，体侧呈现一行行紫黑色条纹

B08.name: 银鲴
B08.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a small hammer-shaped head, an inferior mouth, a thin horny edge on the front of the lower jaw, no barbels, rather large eyes set high on the sides
B08.markings: a patch on the gill cover
B08.colour: 体背部灰黑色，腹部及体下侧银白色，鳃盖有明显的橘黄色斑块

B09.name: 黄尾鲴
B09.form: a thin axillary scale that does not reach the anus
B09.fins: pectoral fins with one stout spine and 15 to 16 rays reaching the front of the pelvic fin origin, an anal fin with three stout spines and 9 to 11 rays, a forked tail fin

B10.name: 赤眼鳟
B10.form: an elongated cylindrical body, the posterior part somewhat flattened, a conical head, a blunt snout, no ventral keel, a terminal arcuate mouth, two pairs of tiny vestigial barbels on the upper jaw, medium-sized eyes set near the tip of the snout, large round scales, a straight lateral line running to the middle of the caudal peduncle
B10.fins: a short dorsal fin without a spine, a short anal fin below and behind the dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin
B10.markings: a row of spots along the flanks formed by a spot at the base of each scale
B10.colour: 眼上半部具红斑，体背青灰色，腹部银白色
